name: Weekly reflection (Friday)
prompt:
It's the weekly reflection. Work through these steps with the student, in order:

0. OFF-WEEK CHECK. Check this week against the academic-year calendar in the `update-journal` skill (the off-weeks: the first two weeks of September, Thanksgiving week, the two winter-recess weeks, the last week of January, the last week of February, the first week of April, the last week of May, and the last week of the school year in June). If this is an off-week, write a one-line note that the reflection is skipped this week and STOP. Otherwise continue.

1. RUN THE JOURNAL. Run the `update-journal` skill's full weekly workflow: (a) the week's record built from recent workspace file changes + this week's decisions.md + the logs + bibliography changes, proposing the top-3 buckets; (b) the Reflection Paragraph the student writes in their own words — this week's peppered STS prompt from the calendar PLUS any stage-fired prompt that came due this week, with the relevant artifacts surfaced, then the open-write; (c) the current-cycle status read. Append each STS response to application-evidence.md under its question heading. Never compose the student's prose; never say whether the reflection is graded.

2. V1c CORPUS-INTEGRITY AUDIT. Confirm every article claimed in reference_articles.md and the reading list has its PDF in articles/ (hard requirement) and its extraction in articles/text/ (soft). If a .md extraction is missing but the PDF is present, auto-regenerate it via `fetch-articles --convert-only`. If a PDF is missing, do NOT auto-fetch it — flag it for the mentor's next session. Capture the result as a one-line status.

3. MAINTAIN-BIBLIOGRAPHY (full verification). Run the `maintain-bibliography` skill's full verification: search up any references now cited in the paper but missing from working_bibliography.md (add as unverified), then walk the student through clicking each unverified DOI / confirming each non-DOI source so it can be marked verified. Never invent a citation or field; never mark an entry verified for the student.

4. V6 ARCHIVAL SNAPSHOT. Invoke the `paper-coverage` skill's archival snapshot: it copies the current working_paper.md into versions/ under a dated filename and reports the delta as a low-key journaling line ('your paper grew by ~N pages this week' / 'unchanged since last week — fine to note'). Archival only — it never reconciles working_paper.md (that is the mentor's compile-working-paper).

5. NOTHING TO PUSH — DRIVE SYNCS ON ITS OWN. The workspace lives in Google Drive (Mirror mode), so everything written this session is already syncing to the teacher's shared view and the Monday digest — there is no commit or push step. (Replaces the former V1b weekly commit+push, retired with the 2026-07-09 Drive-based-workspace decision.)

Do not write project_paper_status.md (read-only; surface any discrepancy to the mentor). Do not grade.
notes: Disabled by default per Hermes distribution-cron convention. The educator enables it after install via `hermes -p review-agent cron enable weekly-reflection`. Schedule '0 15 * * 5' = Fridays 3:00 PM local (edit via `hermes -p review-agent cron edit weekly-reflection`; manual run `hermes -p review-agent cron run weekly-reflection`). Implements the V1 weekly workflow + the closing acts V1c (corpus audit), maintain-bibliography (full DOI verification), V6 (archival snapshot). The former V1b weekly commit+push is retired (Drive Mirror sync is the teacher-visibility heartbeat now, per the 2026-07-09 Drive-based-workspace decision). Off-weeks are handled in the prompt against update-journal's academic calendar. Source of truth: design/weekly-journal-and-sts-evidence-2026-07-08.md; obligations V1/V1b/V1c/V6. V6's archival snapshot is done by the shared `paper-coverage` skill (the read-only coverage+snapshot subset of compile-working-paper); the full round-trip reconcile stays single-homed in the mentor's compile-working-paper. fetch-articles is re-bundled into this profile for the V1c --convert-only regeneration (R7a rule).
